title: Binance Will List MobileCoin (MOB) and Nexo (NEXO)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list MobileCoin (MOB) and Nexo (NEXO) at 2022-04-29 10:00 (UTC). Trading will open for MOB/BTC, MOB/BUSD, MOB/USDT, NEXO/BTC, NEXO/BUSD, and NEXO/USDT trading pairs. Users can now start depositing  MOB  and  NEXO  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for MOB and NEXO will open at 2022-04-30 10:00 (UTC) Note:  The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page. Binance will only support the deposits and withdrawals of the ERC-20 and Polygon network NEXO tokens. MOB and NEXO Listing Fee: 0 BNB. What is MobileCoin (MOB)? MobileCoin is a blockchain that uses Federated Byzantine Agreement, based on the stellar consensus mechanism, which democratizes the digital payment system by enabling global end-to-end encrypted mobile payments instantly. MobileCoin powers mobile apps like Signal to send digital cash without compromising on user security. MOB is the native currency, which can be sent to any mobile phone number and has wallet support for web browsers, desktop and mobile apps. What is Nexo (NEXO)? Nexo is a blockchain-based lending protocol that offers banking services for retail users (e.g. lending, borrowing, trading, credit cards, etc.). Users can deposit their crypto assets on the Nexo platform for various benefits such as generating interest payments, and depositing collateral for loans. The NEXO token is used for governance and platform benefits, as well as to receive interest payments.
